name: 5-ethyl-DMT
summary: 5-Ethyl-N,N-dimethyltryptamine is a tryptamine derivative which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT1A and 5-HT1D serotonin receptors, with around 3x selectivity for 5-HT1D.

pharmacology.text: 5-Ethyl-N,N-dimethyltryptamine is a tryptamine derivative which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT1A and 5-HT1D serotonin receptors, with around 3x selectivity for 5-HT1D.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体的实验室研究。

fact.en: Its preference for the 5-HT1D receptor puts it in the same corner of pharmacology as the triptan migraine drugs, which work on 5-HT1B and 5-HT1D receptors.
fact.zh: 它對5-HT1D受體的偏好，使它在藥理學上與翠普登類（triptan）偏頭痛藥物相近，那些藥物作用於5-HT1B與5-HT1D受體。
fact.zhHans: 它对5-HT1D受体的偏好，使它在药理学上与翠普登类（triptan）偏头痛药物相近，那些药物作用于5-HT1B与5-HT1D受体。
